title: andinia catella
intro: Andinia catella, commonly known as the "Milk Flower", is a plant species that belongs to the orchid family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Andinia catella include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, and its ability to promote relaxation and reduce stress levels. The bioactive constituents of Andinia catella include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
